# XMRBot style system

## Intent

The interface should look durable enough to have existed for a decade: more technical exchange / protocol documentation than AI landing page.

Design constraints:

- no gradients, glass blur, floating neon cards or animated marketing decoration
- square/near-square controls and visible borders
- warm paper/white information surfaces against a charcoal system header
- Monero orange used for identity, emphasis and state—not as ambient decoration
- Georgia/system serif for editorial authority, Arial/system sans for navigation, monospace for numbers and machine surfaces
- compact tables and ledgers instead of oversized dashboard cards
- explicit source/methodology labels
- external Monero software links point to the official getmonero.org download surface
- responsive but desktop information density is intentionally high

The visual references were SafeTrade's dense, long-lived exchange presentation and the Monero Project's restrained orange/gray identity. No assets or layout are copied from either site.
